## Runs 6 / 7 — SdH spot checks at D = 0 (`sdh-spot-check`): electron n = +3.2×10¹² (0 → 10 T), hole n = −1.2×10¹² (10 → 0.3 T)

Raw Rxx(B) first, then the 1/B FFT (5th-order B-space background, log R, two windows). No leakage (gate currents ≤ 0.22 nA offsets), T 1.17–1.29 K.

**Read.** Electron side (run 6): Rxx reaches ≈ 0 between features from ~2 T — quantum-Hall regime well inside the field range. FFT (1.5–10 T, ΔF 1.8 T): **7.1, 15.9, 22.9, 30.0 T** (`sdh_onset`'s matched-filter tracks put the upper three at 14.1 / 22.2 / 29.5 T). These close as **F1 = 7.1, F2 = 22.9, F2 − F1 = 15.8, F1 + F2 = 30.0** — the tone set of *two* Fermi surfaces plus their mixing products, with density shares 0.24 / 0.76 (Bernal-tetralayer λ ratio predicts ≈ 0.28 / 0.72). A single band cannot produce that set (its harmonics would be 30, 60 T). The competing reading — a single 7.1 T family with harmonics 14.2 / 21.3 / 28.4 T (`sdh_onset` flags them that way) — is **not excluded**: the offsets (≈ 1–1.6 T) are inside ΔF = 1.8 T. One density can't split them; the n-dependence does (harmonics scale as k·F1(n), mixing tones as F2 ± F1). ΣF = 30.0 T vs F_L = 33.1 T from the geometry-prior c_tg → the absolute density scale is probably ~0.91× the prior (to be fixed independently from the fan's ν-line slopes). Hole side (run 7): 5.3 T dominant plus 10.6 / ~13–14 T, onset ≈ 0.7 T — messier near the CNP (band-overlap / trigonal-warping regime), not interpretable from one density.

**Take:** suggestive of **two bands (ABAB-like)** on the electron side, not yet evidence — the harmonic reading survives; a single density can't separate mixing tones from harmonics or rule out a series second region (run 5 ridge B, +0.43×10¹²). → the D = 0 Landau fan (plan step 4) — F_i(n) for each tone, and ν-slopes for the absolute density scale. Field window from these runs: oscillations from ≤ 1 T (light tone persists to 0.3 T; heavy tones onset 1.3–1.9 T).

# Runs 6 / 7 — sdh-spot-check at D = 0 (run-5 calibration): raw Rxx(B), then the 1/B FFT per window.
from scipy.signal import find_peaks
from hera.analysis import resolve_channels, sdh_onset
fig, ax = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(12, 7))
for j, (rid, lab) in enumerate([(6, "n = +3.2e12 (electron)"), (7, "n = -1.2e12 (hole)")]):
    r = run(rid); ch = {c.cid: c for c in resolve_channels(r.meta)}
    B = r.col_at(r.col_indices("magnet_field")[0])
    R = np.abs((r.col("sr1_X") / ch["sr1"].gain) / (r.col("sr0_X") / ch["sr0"].gain))
    o = np.argsort(B); B, R = B[o], R[o]
    print(f"run {rid} {lab}: R(B<1 T) median {np.median(R[B < 1]):.0f} Ohm, max {R.max():.0f} Ohm at {B[np.argmax(R)]:.2f} T; "
          f"T {r.col('T_sample').min():.3f}-{r.col('T_sample').max():.3f} K; |I_tg|,|I_bg| max "
          f"{np.abs(r.col('k_2400_tg_curr')).max()*1e12:.0f}, {np.abs(r.col('k_2400_bg_curr')).max()*1e12:.0f} pA")
    ax[0, j].plot(B, R, lw=0.7); ax[0, j].set_xlabel("B (T)"); ax[0, j].set_ylabel("|Rxx| B_1-B_2 (Ohm)"); ax[0, j].set_title(f"run {rid} raw — {lab}")
    for br in [(1.5, 10), (3, 10)]:
        f, sp = sdh_fft(R[:, None], B, b_range=br, nfft=4096, bg_degree=5); sp = sp[0]
        m = f > 2; p, _ = find_peaks(sp, prominence=0.08 * sp[m].max())
        p = sorted([q for q in p if 2 < f[q] < 120], key=lambda q: -sp[q])[:6]
        print(f"   FFT {br[0]}-{br[1]} T (dF {1/(1/br[0]-1/br[1]):.1f} T): " + ", ".join(f"{f[q]:.1f} T ({sp[q]/sp[m].max():.2f})" for q in p))
        ax[1, j].plot(f, sp / sp[m].max(), label=f"{br[0]}-{br[1]} T")
    ax[1, j].set_xlim(0, 80); ax[1, j].set_xlabel("F (T)"); ax[1, j].set_ylabel("|FFT| (norm)"); ax[1, j].legend()
    on = sdh_onset(R, B, r_full_scale=50e-6 / 1e-8)
    print(f"   onset (sdh_onset): {on.onset_b:.2f} T via {on.onset_freq:.1f} T tone; robust tones: " +
          ", ".join(f"{t.freq:.1f}@{t.onset_b:.2f}T" for t in on.tones if not t.marginal))
    print(f"   F_L(prior c scale) = {float(luttinger_frequency((3.2 if rid == 6 else 1.2) * 1e16)):.1f} T")
fig.suptitle("vti-02 sdh-spot-check, D = 0 (run-5 cal), T = 1.2-1.3 K, sr1 50 uV"); fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()

## HERA — Step 4: Landau fan at D = 0 (`landau-fan`) — the band-count read for the stacking call

> **05:25** · landau-fan D=0: n -1.25..+3.25e12 along D=0 (121 pts, (Vtg,Vbg) co-swept) x B 1.0->10.0 T 81 rows uniform in 1/B, Vsi 0, T base, sr1 100 uV, fast\_delay 1 s; ends at 10 T, gates parked 0 · **ETA ~10:10** (≈4h45m)

**Why (plan step 4, `hera_scratch/plan.md`).** Runs 6 / 7 (ana cell "Runs 6 / 7") show SdH on both sides but one density can't decide the band count: the electron-side tone set 7.1 / 15.9 / 22.9 / 30.0 T fits *two* Fermi surfaces with mixing tones (F1, F2−F1, F2, F1+F2; shares 0.24 / 0.76 ≈ Bernal) and *also* a single 7.1 T family with harmonics, within ΔF = 1.8 T. The fan decides it: ABAB → two families, each F_i ∝ n with a fixed share, ΣF_i = F_L; ABCA → one family at F_L (F_L/3 pockets at low n); harmonics scale as k·F1(n), mixing tones as F2 ± F1. The QH ν-lines give the absolute density scale (dn/dB = ν·e/h) independently of stacking, which fixes c_tg (run 6 hints ~0.91× the 9.5 nm prior) and makes the Luttinger-sum test quantitative.

**Design.** Fast axis (Vtg, Vbg) co-swept along the run-5 D = 0 line, n = −1.25 → +3.25×10¹² (the full D = 0 window inside the validators, TG-limited at both ends; 25×10⁹ steps for |n| ≤ 0.75 where the band-edge physics sits, 50×10⁹ beyond — resolves ν = 4 LLs from ~2.5 T, and the per-column FFT does not need fine n). The D = 0 line doesn't depend on the absolute c scale (only the ratio), so recalibrating later moves n labels, not the path. Slow B 1.0 → 10.0 T, **uniform in 1/B**, 81 rows: Nyquist 44 T > F_L(3.25) ≈ 30–34 T, ΔF = 1.1 T over the full window; B_lo = 1 T from the run-6/7 onsets (light tones from ≤ 0.7 T, heavy 1.3–1.9 T). sr1 fixed at **100 µV = 10 kΩ FS** (state0 had left it at 2 µV); τ 0.3 s / 24 dB, fast_delay 1.0 s as in run 5. Same sweep direction every row, so the lock-in lag (~1 point) is a constant n offset, not a slope error. Guards: |I_gate| > 1 nA or T_sample > 2.5 K interrupts. Gates park at 0 at the end; **the field stays at 10 T** so step 5 (±D) can ride it down.

**Coverage trade.** The hole side only reaches −1.25×10¹² (vs +3.25 electron), so hole-side F(n) comes from a short lever arm. 1/B sampling leaves only 9 rows above 5 T: the high-field QH structure is read per row along n, not densely in B. Adding uniform-B high-field rows costs ~2.4 min each. D ≠ 0 is not covered here (step 5).

**Price.** Per row: 121 × 1.10 s (run 5's measured in-row rate) + ~11 s turnaround/settle ≈ 144 s → 81 rows ≈ 3 h 15 m. Field: 10 T at 0.137 T/min = 73 min, including the 0 → 1 T lead-in. Total ≈ 4 h 30 m, **priced at 4 h 45 m** after the session's +5–10 % over-run. **Checkpoints:** (1) first rows (~15 min, after the 7 min lead-in ramp): gate currents at the pA offsets, sr1 not railed away from the CNP column, CNP column near n ≈ 0 (run-5 cal), I_drain ≈ 9.9 nA, R scale 20–300 Ω. (2) ~2 h (B ≈ 2 T, row 44): a 1–2 T column FFT on the landed rows — do the F_i(n) lines appear and how many? (3) ~3 h 40 m (B ≈ 5 T, row 71): preliminary F_i(n) at ΔF 1.25 T. Abort/resize if sr1 rails across many columns (not just at the CNP), or on any trip.

# === Landau fan at D = 0 (`landau-fan`): B slow 1 -> 10 T uniform in 1/B (81 rows) x n fast -1.25 -> +3.25e12 along D = 0 (121 pts) ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD
from hera.analysis import field_invB

# --- session calibration from run 5 (ratio data-calibrated; absolute scale = 9.5 nm prior, to be re-fixed from this fan's nu-slopes) ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
n_vec = np.unique(np.round(np.hstack([np.arange(-1.25, -0.75, 0.05),      # hole side, 50e9 step
                                      np.arange(-0.75, 0.7501, 0.025),    # near CNP, 25e9 step
                                      np.arange(0.80, 3.2501, 0.05)]), 4))  # electron side, 50e9 step
Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec = calc_gate_voltages(n_vec, np.zeros_like(n_vec), CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert len(n_vec) == 121
assert Vtg_vec.min() >= TG_MIN and Vtg_vec.max() <= TG_MAX and Vbg_vec.min() >= BG_MIN and Vbg_vec.max() <= BG_MAX, \
    (Vtg_vec.min(), Vtg_vec.max(), Vbg_vec.min(), Vbg_vec.max())
_nchk, _Dchk = calc_nD(Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert np.allclose(_nchk, n_vec) and np.abs(_Dchk).max() < 1e-9
B_vec = np.round(field_invB(1.0, 10.0, 81), 5)          # ascending, uniform in 1/B: d(1/B) = 0.01125 /T
assert B_vec.min() > 0 and B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP and np.all(np.diff(B_vec) > 0)
print(f"fast: n {n_vec[0]:+.3f} .. {n_vec[-1]:+.3f}e12 ({len(n_vec)} pts); Vtg {Vtg_vec.min():+.4f}..{Vtg_vec.max():+.4f}, "
      f"Vbg {Vbg_vec.min():+.4f}..{Vbg_vec.max():+.4f} V; slow: B {B_vec[0]} -> {B_vec[-1]} T ({len(B_vec)} rows, 1/B-uniform)")

# --- preconditions (state this cell assumes but does not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), T_vap = {T_vaporizer():.3f} K, B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05), V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), "
      f"PS {magnet.persistent_switch_on()} / output {magnet.output_enabled()} (True/True), nplci {k_tg.nplci()}/{k_bg.nplci()} (1/1), "
      f"heater ranges {heater.sample_range()}/{heater.vaporizer_range()} (0/0)")
print(f"precondition lock-ins: drive {sr1.amplitude()} V @ {sr1.frequency()} Hz (1.0 @ 13.777), sr1 tau {sr1.time_constant()} s / {sr1.filter_slope()} dB (0.3/24), "
      f"sr0 sens {sr0.sensitivity()} V (0.02), sr0 tau {sr0.time_constant()} s")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5, f"T_sample {_T0} K off base"
assert abs(_B0) < 0.05, f"magnet not at ~0: {_B0} T"
assert abs(k_si()) < 0.01, "Si gate not at 0"
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()
assert k_tg.nplci() == 1 and k_bg.nplci() == 1
assert heater.sample_range() == 0 and heater.vaporizer_range() == 0, "a heater range is on"
assert abs(sr1.amplitude() - 1.0) < 1e-3 and abs(sr1.frequency() - 13.777) < 0.01, "drive changed"
assert sr1.time_constant() == 0.3 and sr1.filter_slope() == 24 and sr0.time_constant() == 0.3, "tau/slope not what the delays are priced on"
assert sr0.sensitivity() == 0.02, "sr0 sensitivity not 20 mV"

# Fixed sensitivity for the whole fan (no autorange mid-row): 100 uV = 10 kOhm FS at 10 nA (state0 left sr1 at 2 uV).
sr1.sensitivity(100e-6)
FAST_DELAY, SLOW_DELAY = 1.0, 5.0      # 3.3 tau per point (as run 5); 5 s after each field step + gate flyback
I_TRIP, T_TRIP = 1e-9, 2.5             # A on either gate; K on the sample mount
print(f"sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V (10 kOhm FS); fast_delay {FAST_DELAY} s, slow_delay {SLOW_DELAY} s, magnet settle_s {magnet.settle_s} s")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = ("landau-fan D=0: B 1->10 T 81 rows uniform in 1/B; n -1.25..+3.25e12 along D=0 (121 pts, 25e9 step |n|<=0.75, 50e9 beyond), "
                  "run-5 cal (ratio 0.773, c_tg prior 9.5 nm, n_off -0.089e12, D_off -0.013); sr1 100 uV; fast_delay 1 s, tau 0.3 s")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan')
s.add_comment('D = 0 fan; slow magnet.field 1.0 -> 10.0 T, 81 rows uniform in 1/B (d(1/B) 0.01125); fast (Vtg, Vbg) co-swept along D = 0, '
              'n -1.25 .. +3.25e12 cm^-2 (121 pts; 25e9 step for |n| <= 0.75, 50e9 beyond); Vsi = 0; T base; '
              'cal run 5: ratio 0.773, c_tg 2.796e-3 F/m2 (prior), n_offset -0.0894e12, D_offset -0.013 V/nm; n labels in run-5 cal units')

# row layout: [time, B_set, Vtg, Vbg, T_sample, B_meas, I_tg, I_bg, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(magnet.field).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.P); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.P)
s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr); s.plot('time', T_sample); s.plot('time', magnet.field)
IDX_T, IDX_ITG, IDX_IBG = 4, 6, 7

def guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg, t = abs(float(data[IDX_ITG])), abs(float(data[IDX_IBG])), float(data[IDX_T])
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):.3f} T, Vtg={float(data[2]):+.4f}, Vbg={float(data[3]):+.4f}: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
    if t > T_TRIP:
        print(f"T TRIP at B={float(data[1]):.3f} T: T_sample = {t:.3f} K > {T_TRIP} K")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(guard, ())

s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_vec[0]); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_vec[0])
interruptible_sleep(10)
try:
    s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [B_vec], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt], [Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec],
                     slow_delay=SLOW_DELAY, fast_delay=FAST_DELAY)
finally:
    s.ramp(k_tg.volt, 0); s.ramp(k_bg.volt, 0)   # gates parked at 0; field stays where the fan ended (10 T on completion)
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.4f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f}) V, T_sample = {T_sample():.3f} K")
